Class Zoo

java.lang.Object
model.Zoo
public class Zoo extends Object
Represents a Zoo with a name, city, address, budget, and a collection of habitats.

  • Constructor Details

    • Zoo

      public Zoo(String name, String city, String address, double budget)
      Constructs a Zoo object with the specified name, city, address, and budget. Initializes an array to store up to 33 habitats.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the zoo.
      city - The city where the zoo is located.
      address - The address of the zoo.
      budget - The initial budget of the zoo.

  • Method Details

    • testData

      public void testData()
      Populates the zoo with test data for demonstration purposes. This method adds: - Two habitats with predefined attributes. - One animal in the "Sabana" habitat. - Two employees with different roles. - A feeding activity for the animal "Simba". - An enrichment activity in the "Sabana" habitat. - A cleaning activity in the "Sabana" habitat. Preconditions: - The `myHabitats`, `myAnimals`, and `myEmployees` collections must be initialized. Postconditions: - The zoo is populated with sample data for testing.

    • getInformation

      public String getInformation()
      Retrieves the general information of the zoo, including its name, city, address, and budget.
      Returns:
      A string containing the general information of the zoo in the format: "name-city-address-budget".

    • addHabitat

      public boolean addHabitat(String name, int environment, double area, int maxCapacity)
      Adds a new habitat to the zoo. The habitat is created with the specified name, environment, and area. The habitat is added to the first available position in the habitats array. Preconditions: - The 'myHabitats' array must be initialized. Postconditions: - If there is an available position in the `myHabitats` array, the new habitat is added to the zoo.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the habitat.
      environment - The type of environment in the habitat (e.g., jungle, desert).
      area - The area of the habitat in square meters.
      maxCapacity - The maximum capacity of the habitat.
      Returns:
      true if the habitat was successfully added; false if there is no available space in the habitats array.

    • hasAvailableHabitat

      public boolean hasAvailableHabitat()
      Checks if there is at least one available habitat in the zoo. Preconditions: - The `myHabitats` array must be initialized.
      Returns:
      true if there is at least one habitat available; false otherwise.

    • getHabitatList

      public String getHabitatList()
      Retrieves a list of all habitats in the zoo, including their names and environments. Preconditions: - The `myHabitats` array must be initialized.
      Returns:
      A string containing the list of habitats in the format: "name-environment", with each habitat on a new line.

    • addAnimalInHabitat

      public boolean addAnimalInHabitat(String habitatName, String name, double weight, int dietType, String lifeStage, String healthStatus)
      Adds an animal to a specific habitat in the zoo. Preconditions: - The `myHabitats` array must be initialized. * Postconditions: - If a habitat with the specified `habitatName` exists and has available space, the animal is added to the habitat.
      Parameters:
      habitatName - The name of the habitat where the animal will be added.
      name - The name of the animal.
      weight - The weight of the animal in kilograms.
      dietType - The type of diet the animal follows (e.g., herbivore, carnivore, omnivore).
      lifeStage - The life stage of the animal (e.g., juvenile, adult, senior).
      healthStatus - The health status of the animal (e.g., healthy, sick, injured).
      Returns:
      true if the animal was successfully added to the habitat; false if the habitat does not exist or is full.

    • addFeedingActivity

      public String addFeedingActivity(String habitatId, String employeeId, LocalDate schedulingDate, String animalName, double weight)
      Adds a feeding activity to the zoo.
      Parameters:
      habitatId - The unique identifier of the habitat where the activity will take place.
      employeeId - The unique identifier of the employee responsible for the activity.
      schedulingDate - The date when the activity is scheduled.
      animalName - The name of the animal involved in the activity.
      weight - The weight of the food to be provided in the activity.
      Returns:
      A message indicating the result of the operation: - "Error de busqueda, no existe un Habitat, Empleado o Animal con el ID suministrado" if any entity is not found. - "El Animal seleccionado no se encuentra en el Habitat proporcionado" if the animal is not in the specified habitat. - "El Empleado seleccionado no está activo" if the employee is not active. - "El Empleado no esta autorizado para realizar esa actividad" if the employee is not authorized for the activity. - "Actividad registrada exitosamente" if the activity is successfully registered.

    • addCleaningActivity

      public String addCleaningActivity(String habitatId, String employeeId, LocalDate schedulingDate, String description, String usedProducts)
      Adds a cleaning activity to the zoo.
      Parameters:
      habitatId - The unique identifier of the habitat where the activity will take place.
      employeeId - The unique identifier of the employee responsible for the activity.
      schedulingDate - The date when the activity is scheduled.
      description - A description of the cleaning activity.
      usedProducts - A string containing the products used in the cleaning activity, separated by "-".
      Returns:
      A message indicating the result of the operation: - "Error de busqueda, no existe un Habitat o Empleado" if the habitat or employee is not found. - "El Empleado seleccionado no está activo" if the employee is not active. - "El Empleado no esta autorizado para realizar esa actividad" if the employee is not authorized for the activity. - "Actividad registrada exitosamente" if the activity is successfully registered.

    • getEnrichmentDescriptionInMonth

      public String getEnrichmentDescriptionInMonth(LocalDate date)
      Retrieves a concatenated string of descriptions for all enrichment activities that occurred in the same month and year as the specified date. Preconditions: - The `date` parameter must not be null. - The `myActivities` list must not be null and should contain valid `Activity` objects.
      Parameters:
      date - The LocalDate object representing the month and year to filter the enrichment activities by.
      Returns:
      A string containing the descriptions of all enrichment activities that match the specified month and year. If no activities match, an empty string is returned.

    • setUsedProductsInCleaningActivity

      public boolean setUsedProductsInCleaningActivity(String newProducts, String idActivity)
      Updates the list of products used in a cleaning activity identified by the given ID. Preconditions: - The `newProducts` parameter must not be null or empty. - The `idActivity` parameter must not be null or empty. - The `myActivities` list must not be null and should contain valid `Activity` objects. Postconditions: - If a cleaning activity with the specified ID exists, its list of products will be updated with the new products provided.
      Parameters:
      newProducts - A string containing the new products to be set, separated by hyphens ("-").
      idActivity - The ID of the cleaning activity to update.
      Returns:
      true if the cleaning activity with the specified ID was found and updated; false otherwise.

    • countFeedingActivitiesInHabitatInMonth

      public int countFeedingActivitiesInHabitatInMonth(String habitatId, LocalDate date)
      Counts the number of feeding activities that occurred in a specific habitat during the specified month and year. Preconditions: - The `habitatId` parameter must not be null or empty. - The `date` parameter must not be null. - The `myActivities` list must not be null and should contain valid `Activity` objects.
      Parameters:
      habitatId - The ID of the habitat to filter the feeding activities by.
      date - The LocalDate object representing the month and year to filter the feeding activities by.
      Returns:
      The number of feeding activities that match the specified habitat ID and date.

    • getDetailsFromEmployeeActivities

      public String getDetailsFromEmployeeActivities(String idEmployee, LocalDate date)
      Retrieves a concatenated string of details for all activities performed by a specific employee during the specified year. Preconditions: - The `idEmployee` parameter must not be null or empty. - The `date` parameter must not be null. - The `myActivities` list must not be null and should contain valid `Activity` objects.
      Parameters:
      idEmployee - The ID of the employee whose activities are to be retrieved.
      date - The LocalDate object representing the year to filter the activities by.
      Returns:
      A string containing the details of all activities performed by the specified employee during the given year. If no activities match, an empty string is returned.

    • buildCodeInventory

      public String buildCodeInventory()
      Builds a text inventory of the zoo's habitats, employees, animals, and activities. Each non-null item is represented by its class name and identifier on a separate line.
      Returns:
      the inventory as a newline-delimited string, or an empty string if there are no non-null items to include
